rules.title: Boston prohibition on housing discrimination based on rental assistance (source of income)
rules.requirement: In Boston, landlords may not discriminate against renters because they receive rental assistance. This includes refusing to accept Section 8 vouchers, social security disability vouchers or veterans vouchers.
rules.quoted_span: In the City of Boston, it’s illegal to discriminate when renting, buying, selling, or securing financing for any housing.

coverage.notes: Applies to renting, buying, selling, or securing financing for any housing in the City of Boston.

rules.coverage_text: Any housing in the City of Boston, including renting, buying, selling, or securing financing for it.

tool_input.notes: This is an informational page from the Boston Fair Housing Commission. It lists rental assistance (e.g., Section 8 vouchers) as a protected class, so I recorded it as a source-of-income screening restriction. The page does not name the local ordinance, so citation is null. I did not record the general discrimination protections (race, family status, etc.) under the extraction rules.
